Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short.Present Perfect: Sarah has cut her hair.Present Simple: Sarah cuts her hair to feel good. Present Continuous: Sarah is cutting her hair at the the beauty / hair salon.Simple Past: Sarah cut her hair yesterday.Past Continuous: Sarah was cutting her hair while her mother was doing her nails.Sarah was cutting her hair when I arrived. Sarah was cutting her hair at 3.00 pm.2. The floor was dirty. Now it is clean.Present Perfect: The floor has been cleaned. – O chão foi limpo (by my sister)My sister has cleaned the floor. – Minha irmã limpou o chão.Present Simple: My sister cleans the floor once a week to help me.Present Continuous: My sister is cleaning the floor today.Past Simple: My sister cleaned the floor last night.Past Continuous: My sister was cleaning the floor when I arrived (at) home. 3. Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work.Present Perfect: Mark has sold his car. Present Simple: Mark sells cars as his job.Every time Mark walks to work he sees interesting cars to buy.Past Continuous: Mark was walking to work when he saw several interesting cars to buy.Present Continuous: Mark is selling cars below market price / at a discount.Past Simple: Mark sold his car two weeks ago.4. The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.Present Perfect: My mother has cooked /baked a cake.5. They are standing outside because they don't have their keys.Present Perfect: They have lost their keys.6. The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.Present Perfect: It has rained.7. I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty.Present Perfect: I have eaten all the food. I have had lunch. 8. The TV is off and the room is quiet.Present Perfect: My dad has slept. My dad has gone to bed.My dad has gone to sleep. 9. James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain.Present Perfect: James has cut his finger.James has hurt his finger.

enriched.title: Present Perfect e Verbos em Contexto Diário
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Perfect e outros tempos verbais em situações cotidianas. Inclui vocabulário relevante, explicações gramaticais e exemplos práticos para melhorar a compreensão do inglês.
mainTopics: Vocabulário relacionado a ações do dia a dia
Diferenças de Pronúncia entre palavras semelhantes

vocabulary.definition: A person responsible for the development and success of a product.
examples: The product manager is responsible for launching new features.
If successful, we will expand the project.
She was successful in her career.

vocabulary.definition: The action of bringing goods or services to someone.
examples: The delivery arrived yesterday.
The store offers free delivery.

vocabulary.definition: To make a process operate automatically using technology.
examples: We need to automate the system.
Many industries automate their production lines.
You must follow the rules.
The rule is simple: no phones during the meeting.

vocabulary.definition: The function or position someone has in a particular situation.
examples: Her role in the project was crucial.
He played the role of a teacher.

vocabulary.definition: The amount of money needed to buy or do something.
examples: The cost of living is increasing.
The total cost of the project was high.

vocabulary.definition: The land along the edge of the sea.
examples: They spent their vacation on the coast.
The coast is beautiful during the sunset.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions that occurred in the past but have relevance to the present.
rules: Often used with time expressions like 'already', 'just', and 'yet'.
examples: Sarah has cut her hair.
The floor has been cleaned.
Mark has sold his car.
commonMistakes: Confusing Present Perfect with Simple Past.
Using 'has' with plural subjects (e.g., 'They has cleaned').

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions that were in progress at a specific time in the past.
rules: Often used with time markers or interruptions (e.g., 'when', 'while').
examples: Sarah was cutting her hair when I arrived.
My sister was cleaning the floor when I got home.
Mark was walking to work when he saw interesting cars.
commonMistakes: Using 'was' with plural subjects (e.g., 'We was walking').
Forgetting the '-ing' form of the verb.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Sarah ______ her hair yesterday.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action occurred in the past, so Simple Past is used.

practiceQuestions.question: Which tense describes an action with relevance to the present?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Present Perfect is used for actions affecting the present.

culturalNotes: O Present Perfect é amplamente usado em inglês britânico, enquanto o Simple Past é mais comum no inglês americano para ações recentes.
studyTips: Pratique os tempos verbais escrevendo frases sobre seu dia a dia.
Use flashcards para memorizar vocabulário e suas traduções.
Compare frases similares para entender as diferenças entre tempos verbais.
originalExamples: Sarah has cut her hair. (Sarah cortou seu cabelo.)
The floor has been cleaned. (O chão foi limpo.)
Mark has sold his car. (Mark vendeu seu carro.)
My mother has cooked a cake. (Minha mãe fez um bolo.)
They have lost their keys. (Eles perderam suas chaves.)
I have eaten all the food. (Eu comi toda a comida.)
My dad has slept. (Meu pai dormiu.)
James has cut his finger. (James cortou seu dedo.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
